The restart incident (three devs killed mid-final-message, zero work lost because the card copies existed) is the argument that makes (1) durability, not ceremony. **Fold with #11604 item 3** — its collection-criterion widening (plain-text marker accepted; absent HTML-comment marker alone never reads as "report missing") is the PM-side half of this same fix, one governed PR. Draft + human merge.
